data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word phoiton, meaning 'shining'. In Greek mythology, Phedra was the name of several heroines and goddesses. The name Phedra is often associated with loyalty, devotion, and following one's path. The name Phedra carries the meaning “Dweller by the way, Follower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Phedra usually hope their child will grow to embody dweller by the way, follower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
